rationale: Repair generic explanation rendering so DIRECT_FACT findings with predicate `documents` render the approved claim text without exposing governed lineage identifiers as customer-facing semantics. Fidelity validation remains unchanged and continues to reject introduced facts.
supersession_impact: No capability is superseded. This is a bounded repair to the existing evidence-locked deterministic explanation generator.
authority_impact: No authority broadening. Decision approval, explanation authority enforcement, fidelity validation, recommendation prohibition, and evidence-lineage requirements are unchanged. The repair only prevents opaque governed identifiers from becoming customer-facing semantic text.
